# Certificate Analysis: Haryana Institute IT & Management

## 1. Overall Layout and Structure
- **Orientation**: Portrait (A4 size, approximately 8.27" × 11.69")
- **Margins**: 1.5cm all around with a decorative border
- **Main sections** (top to bottom):
  - Header with logo and institute info
  - Certificate title banner
  - Information table (5 columns)
  - Photo placeholder
  - Certification statement
  - Student details section
  - Course information section
  - Examination results section
  - Signature and seal area
  - Footer with logos and contact info
- **Background**: Light gradient from pale yellow to light pink with watermark pattern

## 2. Decorative Border Pattern
- **Style**: Intricate blue lace-like pattern with repeating geometric and floral motifs
- **Thickness**: 1.5cm wide
- **Color**: Royal blue (#1E3A8A)
- **Corner decorations**: Ornate rosette or floral designs at all four corners
- **Pattern density**: Dense, repeating every 2-3cm

## 3. Header Section
- **Logo area**: 
  - Circular emblem on the left (diameter: 6cm)
  - Contains abstract human figures in blue, orange, and yellow
  - "HARYANA" text curved along bottom of circle
- **Institute name**: 
  - "HARYANA INSTITUTE IT & MANAGEMENT" in large orange font (#E67E22)
  - Positioned center-top, spanning ~80% width
- **Registration info**:
  - "Regd. By Labour Department Haryana (Regn. No.: PSA/REG/KTL/LI-KTL-2/0122892)"
  - "Regd. Under Ministry of MSME Govt. of India (UAM No.: HR09D0008909)"
  - "Certified By ISO:9001-2015 (IMS/HIIM/280218/135)"
  - Smaller green font (#2E8B57), centered below institute name

## 4. Text Labels and Positioning
- **Information table** (5 columns, 2 rows):
  - Headers: "Centre Code", "Session", "Enrollment No.", "Roll No.", "Serial No."
  - Values: "Hiim/ktl/001", "2024-2025", "HIIM/S/198030", "8031", "2023033"
  - Position: Centered below certificate title, spanning full width
- **Student details**:
  - "Student Name Mr./Ms./Mrs." → "SUNNY" (right-aligned)
  - "D.O.B." → "07-01-1995" (right-aligned)
  - "S/o D/o W/o" → "ROHTAS" (right-aligned)
  - "Mother's Name" → "RAJ BALA" (right-aligned)
- **Course info**:
  - "Course Name" → "Nursery Teacher Training Course"
  - "Course Duration" → "2 Year"
  - "From" → "May 2023"
  - "To" → "Apr 2025"
- **Examination results**:
  - "He/She has Passed the Final Examination (Conducted by Exam Wing) in" → "Apr 2025"
  - "from Our Authorized Study Centre" → "Haryana institute it & management"
  - "He/She has Passed the Examination with" → "84.30%"
  - "Grade" → "A+"

## 5. Photo Placeholder Area
- **Size**: 8cm × 10cm (portrait orientation)
- **Position**: Centered below information table
- **Border**: Thin blue line (1px)
- **Background**: White

## 6. Decorative Elements
- **Certificate title banner**: Blue ribbon-shaped banner with "Certificate" in white cursive font
- **Horizontal lines**: Thin blue lines separating sections
- **Ornamental patterns**: Small geometric designs between text elements
- **QR code**: Black and white, positioned below signature area

## 7. Signature Areas
- **Two signature areas**:
  - Left: "Sign. of Authorized Signatory" with cursive signature
  - Right: "Seal of Authorized Signatory" with circular blue seal
- **Position**: Bottom third of certificate, spanning full width

## 8. Watermark or Background Patterns
- **Watermark**: Repeating "HARYANA INSTITUTE IT & MANAGEMENT" text in light gray
- **Opacity**: 10-15%
- **Pattern**: Diagonal orientation, repeating every 5cm

## 9. Color Scheme
- **Primary border**: Royal blue (#1E3A8A)
- **Institute name**: Orange (#E67E22)
- **Registration text**: Green (#2E8B57)
- **Certificate banner**: Blue (#2563EB)
- **Text**: Dark blue (#1E40AF) for labels, black for values
- **Background**: Gradient from #FFF9C4 (top) to #FCE4EC (bottom)
- **Seal**: Blue with white text
- **QR code**: Black and white

## 10. Font Styles
- **Institute name**: Bold, serif font, ~36pt
- **Certificate title**: Cursive, white, ~28pt
- **Table headers**: Bold, sans-serif, ~14pt
- **Table values**: Regular, sans-serif, ~12pt
- **Student details labels**: Bold, sans-serif, ~14pt
- **Student details values**: Regular, sans-serif, ~14pt
- **Course info**: Mix of bold and regular, ~14pt
- **Examination results**: Mix of bold and regular, ~14pt
- **Footer text**: Regular, sans-serif, ~10pt

## 11. Stamps or Seal Images
- **Main seal**: Circular, blue border, white center with institute logo
- **MSME logo**: Government of India emblem with "MSME" text
- **ISO logo**: Blue circular badge with "ISO 9001:2015" text

## 12. Grid/Table Structure
- **Information table**: 5 columns, 2 rows, equal width columns
- **Student details**: Two-column layout (label/value) with consistent spacing
- **Course info**: Two-column layout with "From/To" as sub-labels
- **Examination results**: Two-column layout with percentage and grade aligned right

## Spatial Layout Details
- **Vertical spacing**:
  - Header to title: 2cm
  - Title to table: 1.5cm
  - Table to photo: 1cm
  - Photo to certification text: 1.5cm
  - Certification text to student details: 1cm
  - Student details to course info: 1cm
  - Course info to exam results: 1cm
  - Exam results to signature area: 2cm
  - Signature area to footer: 1.5cm
- **Horizontal alignment**:
  - All text elements centered unless specified otherwise
  - Table columns evenly distributed
  - Signature and seal areas aligned left and right respectively

This detailed analysis provides all necessary specifications to recreate the certificate as an HTML/CSS template with pixel-perfect accuracy.
